parsed.name: AT2L0 固体衰减器
parsed.description: 一种电动固体衰减器，含 18 片滤片和 1 个检查镜，用于 LCLS-II XTES 束线中按设定透过率调节 X 射线束强度，并帮助保护下游光学元件和实验样品。
parsed.description_en: A motorized solid attenuator with 18 filters and one inspection mirror, used on the LCLS-II XTES beamline to adjust X-ray beam intensity to a desired transmission and help protect downstream optics and experiments.
